title: Create Requirement Traceability Matrix in Seconds with ChatGPT
quality_rationale: Author identity independently verifiable (channel, instructor page, site); method steps and object clear; no limitations; promotional course links and discount code; single demonstration.
maturity_rationale: Only a self-built example demonstrates that the approach runs; no evaluation design or comparison.

title: ChatGPT Traceability Matrix
quality_rationale: Traceability endpoints are requirement documents, acceptance criteria and user stories linked to tasks and product backlog items and an Excel RTM. All endpoints fall in project management and requirement decomposition; no code, test, issue, commit, design model or compliance artefact is involved, so inclusion condition IG1 is not met and the source was not scored.
maturity_rationale: Not assessed: the source was judged out of scope because inclusion condition IG1 is not met.
notes: Excluded by consensus; the other reviewer excluded the same source on quality grounds.

title: Traceability and AI for Better Understanding, Communication, and QC of Trials
quality_rationale: Presenter named as co-founder and CTO with verifiable affiliation; reproducible method description; balanced account with confidence scores; limitations discussed in depth; new context and method.
maturity_rationale: Industry interviews (600+), use with partners on real datasets, and an FDA exchange; practitioner observation without systematic comparison.

title: ReqTrace: Intelligent Traceability System for Software Engineering Projects
quality_rationale: No institutional affiliation or CV; pipeline described but the extraction model and case object are only partly specified; no limitations; single demonstration; increment limited.
maturity_rationale: Only a self-recorded audio input and a self-built demonstration; no evaluation design or comparison.

title: VectorCAST + AI (Reqs2x)

notes: Method item GQA3 recorded as NA: the source is product documentation without a method section.

title: LLM Assisted Automatic Test Generation and Requirements Traceability
quality_rationale: Presenter and affiliation verifiable; capability path described; limitations discussed at length; transparent about model weaknesses; increment limited to a known toolchain.
maturity_rationale: Industry observation and experience (hallucination behaviour, supplier practice, standards pressure); no systematic comparison.
notes: Shares organisation and workshop series with G6; not an independent industrial voice.

title: LLM-Assisted Automatic MC/DC Test Generation & Requirements Traceability
quality_rationale: Presenter self-identifies with affiliation; reproducible workflow for MC/DC generation and tracing; limitations discussed; new context with an operational process.

notes: Shares organisation and workshop series with G5; not an independent industrial voice.

title: AI-supported traceability and automation with Sphinx-Needs
quality_rationale: Named presenters and organisation; concrete, locatable method; claims supported by demonstration and rules; boundaries discussed; commercial motivation disclosed; curated session.
maturity_rationale: Trial use in a community user group, token comparison between frameworks, and customer self-test feedback; observational only.

title: Building an AI Traceability Agent for Flight Software
